requirements.statement: calendar_store/next_event_match shall implement dual-bank 128×23-bit sparse event lists with S0 registered SRAM read, S1 slot==counter qualification in noc_clk; entries sorted by slot; activation only at slot 0 after old-epoch retirement.
acceptance_criteria: BFM active-bank read fires at entry.slot with loaded inactive-bank contents after handoff.
No active-bank write occurs during replay.
Storage is exactly 5,888 payload bits per router (2×128×23).
Loader rejects lists exceeding 128 entries per bank.

requirements.statement: BG/escape shall use credited XY-DOR vc_buffers with RC→SA→ST pipeline and soft-priority service on non-matching cycles. Conservative hard 1-in-16 bound 328 cycles; soft-prio occupancy-aware bound ~160 cycles on 12-hop worst case. H/V credits 16/20.
acceptance_criteria: test_bg_window and test_bg_bound PASS (conservative bound).
BG never grants over a firing calendar event.
Measured soft-prio 12-hop eligible latency ≤ 160 cycles under max-occupancy premise.
Calendar path never enqueues payload into vc_buffers.

requirements.statement: multicast_fork shall be atomic on out_port_mask; watchdog_demote shall release once and emit lossless XY escape packets for remaining leaves within 2 cycles of available queue capacity.
acceptance_criteria: test_blocked_fork and test_demote_noloss PASS.
Exactly one reservation release per violation.
No drop of preserved flit/context under backpressure.

requirements.statement: μArch shall not instantiate combine_unit or DCA. Reduce/allreduce use Tier-A PE handoff; CAL_OP_PE_HANDOFF is forward/tag only with no router arithmetic.
acceptance_criteria: Router context and BFM builds contain no combine_unit.
Calendar replay for reduce/allreduce completes without router combine results.
uarch.md documents combine/DCA as ABSENT.

requirements.statement: Analytic PPA for the μArch shall report relative area 1.000× (or lower) and power 0.95× vs IQ-XY, below Trial 2's 1.028×/0.96×, with sparse calendar 0.009 and control 0.188.
acceptance_criteria: ppa-analytic.md and ppa_analytic_model.py report 1.000 area.
combine component is 0.000; calendar component is 0.009.
Documented area delta vs Trial 2 is −0.028.

requirements.statement: Single noc_clk domain at 2 GHz; one 512-bit flit per granted direction per cycle; H=7 V=9 ramp=1 modeled as link/PE latency, not a second clock. Global slot counter wraps at 1024.
acceptance_criteria: clock-domain-map.md lists only noc_clk.
BFM/mesh timing uses H=7 V=9 ramp=1.
No CDC synchronizer is required in the μArch.
